purpose: E4: model summoned-unit damage (pets/traps) in champion modules. Pet damage sources: champion ability descriptions (formulas like Illaoi tentacle 9-180 + 110% AD + 40% AP), existing module pet constants (Annie Tibbers burst+aura), wiki 'Champion summoned units' page, and the fight window (rotation/duration). Where the fight model cannot price a pet's autonomous behavior, model its sourced fixed contributions (summon burst, aura, commanded attacks) and document the boundary.

batch1_directed_burst.Annie: Tibbers: summon burst already modeled; ensure aura ticks + Tibbers attacks in window
batch1_directed_burst.Heimerdinger: turrets: Q turret attacks (sourced damage), R upgrade
batch1_directed_burst.Malzahar: voidlings: W summon damage (voidling attacks, 2-4 active)
batch1_directed_burst.Azir: Sand Soldiers: W soldier attacks + Q command dash damage
batch1_directed_burst.Illaoi: tentacles: P spawn + commanded slam damage (9-180 + 110% AD + 40% AP)

batch2_melee_pets.Maokai: Sapling: E throw + explosion (already initial; ensure burn — overlaps E2)
